description: Independently compared kit representations joined to the same candidate deployment. Actual receipt gives bounded search priority only; historical and undated deployments remain eligible. Source-qualified delivery and controlled-purpose evidence never establish an assessment.

seed.description: Exact source identity; labels alone cannot supply joins.

query_date.description: UTC calendar date for 180-day receipt search priority only; never an activity filter.

reference_deployments.description: Explicit baseline deployment records; an empty array supplies no baseline.

include_controlled.description: Explicit analyst inclusion of otherwise evidenced controlled research/test/training/sinkhole occurrences; normal discovery supplies false.
